map.输入两端面积 A₁、A₂、中截面 A_m 与间距 L，按棱台公式求体积，适用于土: Enter the two end areas A1 and A2, the midsection A_m and the spacing L, and compute the volume with the prismoidal formula, which suits earthwork quantity calculation.
map.输入两端面积 A₁、A₂、中截面 A_m 与间距 L，求体积。: Enter the two end areas A1 and A2, the midsection A_m and the spacing L to compute the volume.
map.由两端与中截面面积按棱镜体公式算方量。: Compute volume from the two end areas and the midsection area with the prismoidal formula.
map.比平均断面更准。: More accurate than the average section.
map.：线性变化时与平均断面同；非线性（如锥形）棱镜体更准，避免平均法误差。: With linear variation it matches the average section; with non-linear variation (such as a cone) the prismoidal formula is more accurate and avoids average-method error.
map.由后视前视累计求待定点高程: Elevation of the unknown point from accumulated backsight and foresight
map.V=L/6(A₁+4Am+A₂)，Am 为距中点处截面，辛普森积分近似。: V = L/6(A1 + 4Am + A2), where Am is the section at the midpoint; this is Simpson's integration.
map.断面变化非线性（边坡陡变、堆体）时，平均法系统性偏差，用棱镜体。: When the section changes nonlinearly (steep banks, stockpiles) the average method has a systematic bias, so use the prismoidal formula.
